mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_tb (student_id, student_name, birth, school, address, address_detail, gender, entry_han_date, entry_book_date, created_at, grade_no, level_no, status_no, student_privacy_agree) values (#{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{birth}, #{school}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{gender}, #{entryHanDate}, #{entryBookDate}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{gradeNo}, #{levelNo}, #{statusNo}, #{studentPrivacyAgree});
mapper.select:
SELECT s.student_no AS studentNo, s.student_name AS studentName, s.school AS school, grade.grade AS grade, l.level AS level, CASE WHEN s.gender = true then '남' WHEN s.gender = false then '여' END AS gender, s.birth AS birth, s.address AS address, s.address_detail AS addressDetail, c.center_name AS center, s.entry_han_date AS entryHanDate, s.entry_book_date AS entryBookDate, sh.created_at AS statusModifiedAt, sc.status AS status, sh.reason AS reason, s.created_at AS createdAt,
MAX(CASE WHEN class.class_type = '1' THEN class.class_name END) AS hanClass, MAX(CASE WHEN class.class_type = '2' THEN class.class_name END) AS bookClass
FROM STUDENT_TB s
LEFT JOIN GRADE_CODE grade ON s.grade_no = grade.grade_no LEFT JOIN LEVEL_CODE l ON s.level_no = l.level_no LEFT JOIN CENTER_TB c ON s.center_no = c.center_no
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT student_no, status_no, reason, created_at FROM ( SELECT student_no, status_no, reason, created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY student_no ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rn FROM STATUS_HISTORY ) tmp WHERE rn = 1 ) sh ON s.student_no = sh.student_no LEFT JOIN STATUS_CODE sc ON sh.status_no = sc.status_no LEFT JOIN STUDENT_CLASS stu_class ON s.student_no = stu_class.student_no LEFT JOIN CLASS_CODE class ON stu_class.class_code_no = class.class_code_no
GROUP BY s.student_no

SELECT s.student_no AS studentNo, s.student_name AS studentName, s.school AS school, grade.grade AS grade, l.level AS level, CASE WHEN s.gender = true THEN '남' WHEN s.gender = false THEN '여' END AS gender, s.birth AS birth, s.address AS address, s.address_detail AS addressDetail, c.center_name AS center, s.entry_han_date AS entryHanDate, s.entry_book_date AS entryBookDate, sh.created_at AS statusModifiedAt, sc.status AS status, sh.reason AS reason, s.created_at AS createdAt,
MAX(CASE WHEN class.class_type = '1' THEN class.class_name END) AS hanClass, MAX(CASE WHEN class.class_type = '2' THEN class.class_name END) AS bookClass,
CASE WHEN p.parent_tel_first IS NULL OR p.parent_tel_middle IS NULL OR p.parent_tel_last IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE p.parent_tel_first + '-' + p.parent_tel_middle + '-' + p.parent_tel_last END AS parentTel
FROM STUDENT_TB s
LEFT JOIN GRADE_CODE grade ON s.grade_no = grade.grade_no LEFT JOIN LEVEL_CODE l ON s.level_no = l.level_no LEFT JOIN CENTER_TB c ON s.center_no = c.center_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT student_no, status_no, reason, created_at FROM ( SELECT student_no, status_no, reason, created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY student_no ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rn FROM STATUS_HISTORY ) tmp WHERE rn = 1 ) sh ON s.student_no = sh.student_no LEFT JOIN STATUS_CODE sc ON sh.status_no = sc.status_no LEFT JOIN STUDENT_CLASS stu_class ON s.student_no = stu_class.student_no LEFT JOIN CLASS_CODE class ON stu_class.class_code_no = class.class_code_no LEFT JOIN PARENT p ON p.student_no = s.student_no
WHERE s.student_no = #{studentId}
GROUP BY s.student_no
